name: BJC HealthCare MyChart
registration_note: Epic registration is free and self-service, but the app owner must supply business identity and data-use information, accept Epic's terms, and obtain Clippi-Health's own production public client ID.
registration_steps: Create an Epic on FHIR developer account and register Clippi-Health for Patients, Incoming API, standalone OAuth, and FHIR R4.
Register the exact native-app callback http://127.0.0.1:8765/oauth/callback and the read-only patient APIs Clippi-Health uses.
Complete Epic's Data Use Questionnaire, test with the non-production client ID in the Epic sandbox, then mark the app Ready for Production.
Paste the production public client ID below and test against BJC MyChart. If BJC does not receive it automatically, ask BJC to activate that client ID.
manual_export_steps: Sign in to BJC HealthCare & Washington University MyChart.
Open Your Menu, then choose Document Center.
Choose the record option that best matches the information you want and submit the request.
When MyChart says the record is ready, download it to this computer. Keep the download as a ZIP when MyChart supplies one.
Return to Clippi-Health and choose the downloaded ZIP or record folder.
